correctness.rationale: Direct Fourier diagonalization gives sigma_k=|(1-omega^k)(1+b omega^k)| and a concave quadratic of cosine; only extremal-frequency modes can control the minimum. On even cycles increasing low-frequency and decreasing Nyquist branches cross at exactly the stated weight. On odd cycles a factored branch difference has one crossing before b=d and the entire later branch is below the crossing value; n=3 is explicit. Every boundary, strict equality mode, and large-order expansion is proved algebraically; 392 finite full-matrix or Fourier checks supplement but do not establish infinite claims.

value.rationale: The natural fixed-budget directed graph difference design has a complete all-size optimizer with exact equality frequency sectors; its least mean-zero singular gain controls worst-case stable inversion, increasing by a factor approaching two over the one-hop scheme. Parity decides whether the high-frequency obstruction is Nyquist or two near-Nyquist modes. This is a full structural minimax classification rather than a tiny arbitrary finite computation.
